description: Animations in an AnimationPlayer and states in an AnimationTree state machine. The player and the tree are nodes, so scene_node add puts one in the scene first. read answers with every track of an animation in the shape add_track takes, so a track read off one animation can be added to another. add_track on a path the animation already has a track of that type for adds the keys to that track, as the editor keys a property it already animates, answering existingTrack true and keysAdded beside keys, the track's count; a key at a time that track already has a key at is refused. A key past the animation's end, where it never plays, is written and named under pastLength. remove_track takes out every track of the type, nodePath and property given, with its keys. remove clears the player's autoplay when it named the animation and names under statesPlayingNothing the states that played it, which stay in their trees playing nothing until remove_state takes them out. Every state machine has Start and End, which cannot be added or removed; a transition from Start sets the state it begins in. read and read_states need no editor: one serving the project answers and says whether it holds unsaved changes to the scene, and with none a headless engine reads the file without running the scene's scripts. The ops that write go through the editor when one serves the project; with none, a headless engine runs the editor's own tool and the answer says so under writtenBy. That engine runs every script of the file, where the editor runs only tool scripts, so what a script changes as the file loads is put back before anything is saved, and a file where that cannot be done, such as a scene whose script does not compile, is refused and nothing is written. An editor of the project that is running and has not reached this server is waited for rather than written around. Operations: read (needs playerNodePath): the animations of an AnimationPlayer, or one with its tracks; read_states (needs animTreePath): the states and transitions of an AnimationTree state machine; create (needs playerNodePath, animationName): a new animation in an AnimationPlayer; add_track (needs playerNodePath, animationName, track): a property or method track with keyframes; remove_track (needs playerNodePath, animationName, track): a track and its keys from an animation; set (needs playerNodePath, animationName): an animation's length, loop mode or step; rename (needs playerNodePath, animationName, newName): an animation, with what plays it; remove (needs playerNodePath, animationName): an animation from its player; add_state (needs animTreePath, stateName, animationName): a state playing an animation, in an AnimationTree; remove_state (needs animTreePath, stateName): a state and its transitions from an AnimationTree; connect_states (needs animTreePath, fromState, toState): a transition between two states; disconnect_states (needs animTreePath, fromState, toState): the transition from one state to another.

advanceCondition.description: connect_states: the condition parameter that advances. Only for op connect_states.

animTreePath.description: The AnimationTree node. Only for ops read_states, add_state, remove_state, connect_states, disconnect_states.

animationName.description: The animation in the player. read: the one to answer with whole, its tracks a list; without it, read lists them, each with the number of its tracks under tracks. add_state: the one that state plays. One the player does not have yet is written all the same, answering animationFound false and why under animationMissing. Only for ops read, create, add_track, remove_track, set, rename, remove, add_state.

fromState.description: connect_states and disconnect_states: the state the transition leaves. Only for ops connect_states, disconnect_states.

length.description: create and set: seconds, more than 0. create: default 1. set: a key past the new end is kept, as the editor keeps it, and named under pastLength, since it never plays. Only for ops create, set.

loopMode.description: create: default none. Only for ops create, set.

newName.description: rename: the animation's new name in the library it is in. The player's autoplay and every state of the scene's AnimationTrees that plays it are renamed with it, named under autoplay and statesFollowed. Only for op rename.

playerNodePath.description: The AnimationPlayer node. Only for ops read, create, add_track, remove_track, set, rename, remove.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn".

stateMachinePath.description: A nested state machine, by the names of the states that lead to it. Default the root. Only for ops read_states, add_state, remove_state, connect_states, disconnect_states.

stateName.description: add_state: the state to add. It goes right of the rightmost state in the editor's graph, answered under position. remove_state: the state to take out, with every transition leaving or reaching it, named under transitionsRemoved. Only for ops add_state, remove_state.

step.description: create and set: keyframe snap in seconds, 0 or more. create: default 0.1. Only for ops create, set.

toState.description: connect_states and disconnect_states: the state it arrives at. Only for ops connect_states, disconnect_states.

track.description: add_track: the track to add. remove_track: the track to take out, found by its type, nodePath and property as read answers them; its keyframes are not needed. Only for ops add_track, remove_track.

keyframes.description: add_track: the keys to add, each at its own time.

args.description: For method tracks: the arguments to call with.

value.description: For property tracks: the value at this time.

method.description: For method tracks: the method to call. The answer's methodFound says whether the target node has it; a method it lacks is still added, since it may be written next, and until it exists each call the track makes fails.

nodePath.description: Target node, relative to the AnimationPlayer root.

property.description: For property tracks: the property to animate.

type.description: add_track makes property and method tracks; remove_track takes any type read answers.

transitionType.description: connect_states: default immediate. Only for op connect_states.

name: scene_animation
title: Animations
